summary: Merge Gateway routes every major LLM through one API with built-in routing, spend caps, and security. The Pro plan grants $10 in complimentary LLM credits every month (issued on the 1st of each month), with unused credits expiring at month end. A credit card is required.
claim_steps: Choose the Pro plan (requires a credit card).
Receive $10 in complimentary credits each month; use them against any supported model via the gateway.merge.dev/v1 endpoint.
